title: DOW-UAP-PR108, Unresolved UAP Report, Western United States, 2020
what_is_it: A US military infrared surveillance video of an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), submitted to a government resolution office.
interpretation_warnings: No PDF body text was extracted; almost all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the video description, not a written report.
The 'area of contrast' is only an infrared heat/contrast blob — the video does not identify what the object is, its size, distance, or speed.
Case is officially unresolved: 'unresolved' does not imply an exotic or non-human origin.
Single-source, single-sensor observation with no corroborating radar, second sensor, or eyewitness data described.
Sensor zoom and contrast settings changed repeatedly, which can affect apparent motion and appearance of the tracked object.

key_facts.source_quote: video footage from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform in 2020
